title: Florida Steakhouse Hosts Monthly Nude Dining Nights as Officials Confirm Event Is Legal - NewsBreak
text:
By Will Kennedy ,
7 hours ago Image by Sora Shimazaki on Pexels, Valeria Boltneva on Pexels. A Florida steakhouse that promotes itself on its website is offering customers a dining experience unlike most restaurant outings: a five-course meal where guests can choose to eat completely nude. According to Axios , C.L.A.S.S. Soirée Steakhouse in Hollywood, Florida, launched its monthly “Nude Dining Experience” to attract attention and bring more customers to the small restaurant.
According to event details, guests receive a five-course steakhouse meal that includes filet mignon, Florida lobster tail, truffle mac and cheese, and dessert. Guests also receive a champagne toast and dine alongside other attendees.
Tickets cost $250 for men, $150 for women, and $300 for couples, according to details reported about the event. The restaurant limits attendance to keep attendance limited, with reports indicating each dinner accommodates approximately 20 guests. The nude dinners take place on the first Monday of each month and require reservations.
Guests Must Follow Privacy and Conduct Guidelines According to WFLA , the restaurant requires guests to be at least 18 years old and follow rules requiring respectful conduct. Its guidelines prohibit touching without consent and state that the restaurant reserves the right to refuse service.
To comply with local regulations, guests can choose whether to remain clothed or undress during the event, according to The Independent . Additionally, the experience takes place in a private lounge adjacent to the main dining room, where guests must sit on provided towels or robes to uphold hygiene standards.
Owner and chef Maurad Ali told local media that the restaurant maintains a professional environment. Guests do not have to arrive naked . The restaurant provides seat cushions, allowing diners to decide how comfortable they want to become during the evening.
Hollywood municipal spokesperson Joann Hussey told media outlets the event complies with local rules because employees remain clothed. The restaurant continues to advertise the monthly experience through its official channels and reservation platforms.
Ali Says a Private Event Inspired the Recurring Experience Ali told Axios the idea came after a nudist group rented the restaurant for a private event. He said he hoped the concept would generate conversation and help distinguish the business from other local restaurants.
